ACT TWO · MICRO POCKETS
05Three Sections MapGRAPHICMeasuring less than 1.5 square miles, Hermosa can be broadly divided into 3 sections: Sand, Valley, and Hill. The real story, however, is found in the micro pockets.LOCKED
